items.headline: Basketball Hall of Fame Welcomes Illustrious Class of 2026
items.summary: NBA luminaries Amar'e Stoudemire, Mike D'Antoni, and Doc Rivers were formally inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame on Saturday, August 15. The celebrated class also includes WNBA legends Candace Parker and Elena Delle Donne, along with veteran referee Joey Crawford.

items.headline: Jaylen Brown Joins Philadelphia 76ers in Blockbuster Offseason Trade
items.summary: In a stunning move earlier this offseason, Jaylen Brown was traded from the BOS Celtics to the rival PHI 76ers. The deal sets up an anticipated return to Boston for Brown on January 21, 2027.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Headed to Miami Heat
items.summary: Former MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo was traded from the MIL Bucks to the MIA Heat, as speculation surrounding his future concluded. Antetokounmpo's first game back in Milwaukee with the Heat is scheduled for January 28, 2027.

items.headline: Warriors Confident in Stephen Curry Extension
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors anticipate reaching a contract extension with superstar Stephen Curry, aiming for him to conclude his career with the franchise. General Manager Mike Dunleavy expressed confidence in a deal, though timing might be flexible to manage cap space.

items.headline: Lonnie Walker IV Signs One-Year Deal with Denver Nuggets
items.summary: Lonnie Walker IV is returning to the NBA after a season in the EuroLeague, signing a one-year, $3.3 million deal with the DEN Nuggets. Walker last averaged 12.4 points with the 76ers in 2025-26.

items.headline: Dillon Brooks Extends with Phoenix Suns for Three Years
items.summary: Canadian standout Dillon Brooks has agreed to a three-year, $73 million extension with the PHX Suns. Brooks had a career-best 20.2 points in 56 games for Phoenix last season.

items.headline: Caleb Houstan Joins New Orleans Pelicans on One-Year Deal
items.summary: Former Magic second-round pick Caleb Houstan has signed a one-year contract with the NOP Pelicans. The Canadian forward is a career 37.8% three-point shooter.

items.headline: Jeremy Sochan Heads to Portland Trail Blazers
items.summary: After winning a championship with the NY Knicks, Jeremy Sochan has signed a one-year deal with the POR Trail Blazers. Sochan averaged career lows in points, rebounds, and assists last season.

items.headline: Gary Payton II Returns to Golden State Warriors
items.summary: Veteran guard Gary Payton II has re-signed with the GSW Warriors on a one-year, $3.9 million deal. Payton II averaged 7.5 points and 3.6 rebounds last season.

items.headline: Austin Reaves Inks Four-Year, $180M Extension with Lakers
items.summary: Austin Reaves has committed his long-term future to the LAL Lakers, signing a four-year, $180 million contract extension. The deal solidifies Reaves's role with the Lakers moving forward.

items.headline: Full 2026-27 NBA Regular Season Schedule Unveiled
items.summary: The NBA officially released its complete schedule for the 2026-27 season on August 13, with opening night set for October 20. The schedule features a tripleheader to kick off the season, highlighted by LeBron James and the PHI 76ers visiting the defending champion NY Knicks.

items.headline: Christmas Day Slate Features Five Marquee Matchups
items.summary: The highly anticipated Christmas Day schedule includes five exciting games: Spurs at Knicks, Heat at Celtics, 76ers at Lakers, Thunder at Timberwolves, and Nuggets at Warriors.

items.headline: NBA to Host International Regular Season Games in Paris and Manchester
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs and New Orleans Pelicans will face off in two international regular season games in January 2027, playing in Paris, France (Jan. 14) and Manchester, United Kingdom (Jan. 17).

items.headline: Training Camps Set to Open in Late September
items.summary: With the offseason winding down, NBA teams are preparing for the start of training camps, which are scheduled to officially open around September 29. Preseason action is slated to begin on October 3.
